_note: Slide 29. Retention policy is a security decision with a price tag attached. Attached via ism_template rather than the deprecated index-level policy_id setting. The cold state needs a registered snapshot repository - run 'make snapshot-repo' first, or bootstrap will warn and leave the policy in place with the cold transition unusable.

policy.description: Chasing shadows: hot -> warm -> cold -> delete for security logs and agent traces

states.name: hot
states._note: 0-3 days. Raw spans and flows on NVMe. Segment replication means primaries stopped paying twice for indexing.

states.name: warm
states._note: 3-30 days. Segments already live in the remote store, so a lost warm node is a restore, not a re-ingest.

states.name: cold
states._note: 30-90 days at roughly 12% of volume: identity, DNS, cloud audit and the agent rollup. Everything else is deleted on day 30.
